# Synthetic catalogue fixtures

Every data value is invented. `scripts/build-synthetic-fixtures.mjs` rebuilds these CSV/XLSX twins after the importer build; the other existing fixture folders contain the original researched layouts. No real export values or PDFs are included.

| Fixture                           | Header evidence                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| --------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Binance order statuses            | Exact real header from catalogue §1.3, including superscripts and duplicate `Time`; statuses include the API enum documented there                                                                                             |
| CoinDCX order statuses            | Exact real header from catalogue §2.2; every documented status                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Binance convert                   | Exact header from export-formats §A7; successful and explicitly unverified pending status                                                                                                                                      |
| Binance fiat deposit              | Exact header from export-formats §A6; successful and unverified pending status                                                                                                                                                 |
| Binance wallet legacy deposit     | Exact combined header from export-formats §A5/A6                                                                                                                                                                               |
| Binance statement all operations  | Exact header from export-formats §A4; every listed operation, both capitalization variants for dust, every income kind, negative Distribution, internal moves, futures/margin, and unknown operations including a blank Change |
| Binance trade assets unverified   | Third-party A3 header; registry is explicitly unverified                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Binance futures trades unverified | Third-party A7 / catalogue §1.8 header; registry is explicitly unverified                                                                                                                                                      |
| Binance futures transactions      | Exact A7 header; all four example operation strings plus an unknown type                                                                                                                                                       |
| CoinDCX futures INR unverified    | Only the documented P&L headers plus descriptive ID/time/type markers from B5; this is a partial synthetic layout, not a claimed real header row                                                                               |
| CoinDCX options unverified        | Only three distinctive descriptive markers from catalogue §2.3; this is a partial synthetic layout, not a claimed real header row                                                                                              |

XLSX twins for existing Binance fills, deposits/withdrawals and CoinDCX orders preserve the original header exactly. Existing `coindcx-report.xlsx` supplies Instant Orders, Spot Orders and USDT-M futures coverage. Tests also exercise fixed offsets and explicit UTC, raw preservation, repeated imports and fees with/without explicit GST.

`test/pdf-fixture.ts` builds unencrypted and encrypted PDF statements in memory using Node crypto and a tiny fixture-only PDF Standard R2 security handler. The eight-digit password is synthetic. These fixtures prove password handling and positioned-table reconstruction; they do not establish compatibility with a real Binance layout or test modern AES encryption specifically. PDF.js handles encryption in production. No qpdf or additional package is needed.

The previous statement tests expected overlapping rows to be skipped and unknown operations to be errors. They now assert grouped raw provenance and flagged unknown rows, as required by catalogue §1.5. The workbook test now retains its known futures row as review-only; the two rows with explicitly invented wallet headers still produce visible row errors.

Order-history swap-buy price assertions changed to `1` quote unit per outgoing quote unit. The engine values a swap from its outgoing quantity; using the base-asset order price there would multiply the disposal value twice. The original execution price remains untouched in `raw`, matching the existing fill importer convention.
